episodes.title: The Lady in White
episodes.description: A beautiful lady in white is leading children into the dark. She was buried days ago.

scenes.narration: A lady in white is luring children into the dark. And she was buried days ago.
scenes.visual: Lucy in a white burial gown leading a small child through a misty graveyard

scenes.narration: London's newspapers are full of it.
scenes.visual: A Victorian newspaper being read under a gas lamp

scenes.narration: Children vanish from the heath at night, and turn up at dawn.
scenes.visual: Children playing at the edge of a heath at twilight

scenes.narration: Each with tiny wounds on the throat.
scenes.visual: A worried mother holding a sleepy child with a bandaged neck

scenes.narration: They all describe the same beautiful lady.
scenes.visual: A small child pointing toward misty woods, a faint white figure among the trees

scenes.narration: Van Helsing takes Seward to Lucy's tomb at midnight.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing and Seward with a lantern at a stone tomb door at night

scenes.narration: They open her coffin. It's empty.
scenes.visual: An open empty coffin in a crypt, lantern light

scenes.narration: They wait among the graves, until something white moves in the fog.
scenes.visual: Two men hiding behind gravestones as a white figure drifts through fog

scenes.narration: It's Lucy. Carrying a child.
scenes.visual: Lucy in a white burial gown carrying a child through a misty graveyard

scenes.narration: Her lips are red with blood. In Part 12, Arthur has to face her.
scenes.visual: Close-up of Lucy's pale face with blood-red lips and cold eyes

episodes.title: The Hardest Goodbye
episodes.description: The woman Arthur loves is calling his name from her tomb. Only he can set her free.

scenes.narration: The woman Arthur loves is calling his name, from outside her own tomb.
scenes.visual: Lucy in white, arms outstretched, smiling coldly by a tomb door at night

scenes.narration: Van Helsing brought him here at midnight, with Quincey and Seward.
scenes.visual: Men with lanterns at a churchyard gate at midnight

scenes.narration: Come to me, Arthur, she whispers.
scenes.visual: Arthur frozen, staring, a lantern trembling in his hand

scenes.narration: Van Helsing raises a crucifix, and she snarls like an animal.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing raising a golden crucifix as Lucy snarls and recoils

scenes.narration: She can't get back into her tomb. He sealed the door with holy bread.
scenes.visual: Lucy hissing at a tomb door sealed with white paste

scenes.narration: At dawn, they find her asleep in her coffin, more beautiful than ever.
scenes.visual: Lucy lying in her coffin, flushed and beautiful, lit by lanterns

scenes.narration: There's only one way to free her. And Arthur must do it himself.
scenes.visual: Arthur holding a wooden stake and a hammer, hands shaking

scenes.narration: One blow. Through the heart.
scenes.visual: Silhouette of a raised hammer above a coffin in a dark crypt

scenes.narration: Her face softens. She's Lucy again. At peace.
scenes.visual: Lucy's face serene and gentle in her coffin, warm light

scenes.narration: Now they know what they're hunting. In Part 13, they find out where it hides.
scenes.visual: Four men clasping hands in a candlelit crypt

episodes.title: Fifty Coffins
episodes.description: Somewhere in London are fifty boxes of earth, and the Count sleeps in them.

scenes.narration: Somewhere in London are fifty boxes of earth. The Count sleeps in them.
scenes.visual: A map of London marked with pins and small drawings of crates

scenes.narration: Jonathan and Mina join the hunters.
scenes.visual: Jonathan and Mina arriving at a Victorian house, greeted by Van Helsing

scenes.narration: Jonathan has already seen the Count in a London street, looking years younger.
scenes.visual: Jonathan frozen in shock on a busy London street, a tall dark figure in a top hat in the crowd

scenes.narration: Mina pieces every diary and letter into one record.
scenes.visual: Mina at a typewriter surrounded by diaries and letters

scenes.narration: And the plan becomes clear.
scenes.visual: The group gathered around a table covered in papers and a map of London

scenes.narration: By day, the Count must rest in the earth of his homeland.
scenes.visual: Rows of wooden crates in a dark cellar

scenes.narration: Destroy the boxes, and he has nowhere left to hide.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing tapping the map with his finger, eyes fierce

scenes.narration: To keep Mina safe, the men leave her out of the hunt.
scenes.visual: Mina standing alone in a doorway as the men leave with lanterns

scenes.narration: That was a mistake.
scenes.visual: An empty dark hallway, a curtain moving in a draught

scenes.narration: Every morning, Mina wakes up paler. In Part 14, the hunters walk into his lair.
scenes.visual: Mina waking in bed at dawn, pale, touching her throat

episodes.title: The House of Rats
episodes.description: The hunters break into the Count's lair, and the floor comes alive.

scenes.narration: The floor comes alive with rats. Thousands of them.
scenes.visual: Thousands of rats with glowing eyes swarming across a stone floor

scenes.narration: The hunters have broken into Carfax, the Count's ruined house.
scenes.visual: Men with lanterns forcing open the oak door of a decaying mansion

scenes.narration: Inside, the air smells of death.
scenes.visual: A dusty chapel interior piled with wooden crates in dim lantern light

scenes.narration: One by one, they seal his boxes with holy bread.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing crumbling a white wafer into an open crate of earth

scenes.narration: Then the rats pour out of the walls.
scenes.visual: Rats pouring out of cracks in a stone wall

scenes.narration: Arthur whistles, and his terriers tear into them.
scenes.visual: Terrier dogs charging into a swarm of rats

scenes.narration: Next door, Renfield had begged to be released that evening.
scenes.visual: Renfield at the bars of his cell, pleading desperately

scenes.narration: Calm. Sane. Terrified. Seward said no.
scenes.visual: Seward turning away from the cell door, troubled

scenes.narration: Now a guard hears a scream from his cell.
scenes.visual: A guard running down a dark asylum corridor with a lamp

scenes.narration: Renfield lies broken on the floor. In Part 15, his last words change everything.
scenes.visual: A broken man lying on a cell floor in deep shadow

episodes.title: Unclean
episodes.description: Renfield's dying confession sends the hunters running to Mina's room.

scenes.narration: They break down the door, and find the Count holding Mina.
scenes.visual: Silhouette of the Count gripping a woman by a moonlit window, cloak swirling

scenes.narration: Minutes earlier, the dying Renfield had confessed.
scenes.visual: Renfield whispering to Seward and Van Helsing with his last strength

scenes.narration: He let the Count in. And the Count has been visiting Mina.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing's face filled with horror in lamplight

scenes.narration: The men raced up to the Harkers' room.
scenes.visual: Men running up a dark staircase with lanterns

scenes.narration: Jonathan lay in a trance on the bed.
scenes.visual: Jonathan lying unconscious on a bed in moonlight

scenes.narration: And the Count was forcing Mina to drink his blood.
scenes.visual: Close-up of the Count's furious face in moonlight, a woman's hand pushing weakly against his chest

scenes.narration: Van Helsing raises the holy bread. The Count backs away, hissing.
scenes.visual: The Count recoiling and snarling from a raised white wafer

scenes.narration: He turns to mist, and slips under the door.
scenes.visual: A cloud of pale mist drifting under a door

scenes.narration: Mina covers her face.
scenes.visual: Mina weeping with her hands over her face

scenes.narration: Unclean, she cries. Unclean. In Part 16, the hunters strike back.
scenes.visual: Close-up of Mina's tear-streaked face in shadow
